newsitem.title: USA: Conrail has tentative pact with engineers.
newsitem.headline: Conrail has tentative pact with engineers.

text.p: Conrail Inc said Tuesday it has reached a tentative agreement with the General Committee of the Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers on a new labor contract.

The agreement covers all outstanding issues between the parties, including wages, health and welfare benefits and work rules, the railroad said. Details are being withheld pending membership ratification.
With this agreement, Conrail said, it has reached agreement with unions representing 85 percent of its employees subject to collective bargaining.
The union represents over 2,500 engineers on Conrail.

It quoted Robert Godwin, General Chairman of the BLE General Committee on Conrail, as saying: "During the entire negotiations process with Conrail, we had one goal and that was to get the best agreement possible for our members. This proposed agreement not only has accomplished this, we feel it is the best agreement in the railroad industry."
